statement: TLINK 2.0 (/c /d /s) of C0L (reassembled from STARTUP/C0.ASM), the toolbox module, G1 and G2 (each one Turbo C 2.0 compile of its unit: functions, initialised data, BSS) with the stock CL.LIB gives the unpacked image of every episode byte for byte (image, relocation set, header); LZEXE 0.91 packs it into the original DN1.EXE / DN2.EXE / DN3.EXE (SHA-256 equal to layout/oracle.lock.json).
